# Code 'n' Kraft

> Website design, development and search-visibility studio — SEO, AEO and GEO. Based in India, serving clients globally.

## Services

- [Website Design](https://codenkraft.com/services/website-design): Custom website design and development built to rank and convert.
- [Rebrand](https://codenkraft.com/services/rebrand): Complete brand identity refresh — logo, visuals and messaging.
- [SEO](https://codenkraft.com/services/seo): Search engine optimization to rank higher on Google.
- [AEO](https://codenkraft.com/services/aeo): Answer engine optimization — get cited in AI answers and featured snippets.
- [GEO](https://codenkraft.com/services/geo): Generative engine optimization — visibility across ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI search.
- [UI/UX Design](https://codenkraft.com/services/ui-ux): User interface and experience design.
